newsitem.title: ROMANIA: RADIO ROMANIA AFTERNOON HEADLINES AT 4 PM.
newsitem.headline: RADIO ROMANIA AFTERNOON HEADLINES AT 4 PM.

text.p: * Finnish Minister for European Affairs Ole Norrback met President Emil Constantinescu and Foreign Minister Adrain Severin on Monday. Severin and Norrback discussed developing an infrastructure to link the Baltic Sea with the Black Sea and the Mediteranean Sea.
They also focused on Finland's support for Romania's efforts to join the European union.
* Finnish businessmen who accompanied Norrback met potential Romanian partners in steel industry, ship and industrial building, environmental protection and cellular telephones.

* The Romanian army must pursue its efforts to obtain NATO membership and implement reforms, newly appointed Chief of Staff General Constantin Degeratu told a news conference. He praised his predecesor, General Dumitru Cioflina.

* The costs for Romania to update its military equipment and ensure "inter-operativity" with NATO forces are estimated at $4 billion until the year 2004, said General Dan Zaharia, responsible for army procurement. -- Bucharest Newsroom 40-1 3120264
